result.title: A Common Language for Dynamic Graphs: Interaction Tokenization Enables Foundation Models
result.summary: Dynamic graphs capture evolving interactions in Web systems, including online communication, user engagement, and recommendation. Graph foundation models aim to reuse predictive capabilities across networks, but extending this capability to dynamic graphs faces two challenges. First, node identities are graph-specific, and similar interaction patterns can appear at different temporal and activity scales, making histories difficult to represent consistently across networks. Second, the predictive roles of historical patterns vary across interaction dynamics, limiting transfer from a narrow range of training processes. In this paper, we show that a common interaction language, combined with learning across diverse interaction processes, offers a basis for dynamic graph foundation modeling. We propose CL-DGFM, a Common Language Dynamic Graph Foundation Model for temporal link prediction. Its Dynamic Interaction Tokenizer encodes interaction memory, historical connectivity, and ordered destination transitions into calibrated tabular inputs, making dynamic histories accessible to existing predictors without an additional trainable graph encoder. Its Dynamic Interaction Prior trains a pretrained tabular foundation predictor across diverse synthetic dynamics. Labeled historical context guides prediction, with a Contextual Value Adapter modulating attention values. The model transfers to real graphs without target-graph parameter updates. Experiments on TGB and TGB-Seq demonstrate competitive performance. Further comparisons show that the common language supports basic machine learning and neural models, and enables direct use of frozen tabular foundation models on dynamic graphs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CL-DGFM，用于动态图上的时序链接预测：用 Dynamic Interaction Tokenizer 将交互记忆、历史连通性和有序目标转移编码为表格输入，并借助 Contextual Value Adapter 调节注意力值，在多种合成动态过程上预训练表格基础预测器，迁移到真实图时无需更新目标图参数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把历史状态外化为有序 token 并由上下文调节注意力值」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何组织、视觉证据如何注入预测器提供可核查线索，但尚需确认这是否只是输入层文本化而非真正的推理期状态更新。
